title: Canonical associator and Koszul symmetry for normalized etale tensor models
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme, $\Lambda$ a commutative ring, and let the unbounded derived category of modules over the sheafified constant ring on its lifted etale site be given. Write $A_T$ for the actual ringed tensor corner and $a$ for any RingedTensorModel of $A_T$, as in [def-pur-etale-ringed-projection-presentation]. Suppose its representative isomorphism $r_{P,Q}:Q\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes Q)\xrightarrow{\sim}QP\otimes^L QQ$ satisfies $\mu_{P,Q}r_{P,Q}=1$ for every pair of flat-term K-flat complexes, where $\mu$ is the native localization lax tensorator. Then $a$ admits TensorConstraints [def-sfb-ringed-projection-coherence-data] with associator exactly the native derived associator $\alpha$, and symmetry exactly the native derived Koszul braiding. In particular they are natural in all variables and satisfy the specified representative equations for the unsigned total associator and the signed total swap. The assertion imposes no extra hypotheses on $T$, $\Lambda$ or the degrees of the complexes.

proof.text: The localization tensorator is invertible when a factor is K-flat. Cancel it in ModelNormalized to identify the representative comparison with its inverse. Total tensor of flat-term K-flat complexes again has flat terms and is K-flat.

source.place: Tags 06YU and 07A4: descent of signed total tensor associator and Koszul symmetry

proof.text: Choose the native derived associator and native derived braiding. Naturality gives their naturality fields. Invert the lax tensorator associativity identity to get the representative associator equation. For symmetry use the native braiding representative equation and cancel the two localization tensorators. The total braiding has the same Koszul sign in all bidegrees.

lean.statement:
theorem etale_ringed_normalized_constraints (T : Scheme.{u})
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (Modules (topology T) Λ)]
    (a : SheafOfModules.RingedTensorModel (corner T Λ)) (ha : ModelNormalized T Λ a) :
    ∃ t : SheafOfModules.ProjectionCoherence.TensorConstraints (corner T Λ) a,
      (∀ E F G : DerivedCategory (Modules (topology T) Λ),
        t.associator E F G = α_ E F G) ∧
      (∀ E F : DerivedCategory (Modules (topology T) Λ),
        t.symmetry E F = DerivedMonoidal.braiding'
          (DerivedCategory.Qh (C := Modules (topology T) Λ))
          (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (Modules (topology T) Λ) (.up ℤ)) E F)
